title: Centre extends CAPF deployment in Delhi in view of INDIA bloc protest
description:
The Centre has extended for the third time the deployment of 270 Central Armed Police Forces (CAPF) companies in Delhi till November 16 in view of the INDIA bloc rally at Ramlila this weekend and the possibility of "flash protests" by certain groups, official sources said on Thursday.
These combat units were brought to Delhi for the protests by the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) early this month.
The Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) on Thursday extended the deployment of a total of 270 companies in Delhi from October 31 to November 16 in view of the INDIA bloc protest and rally at Ramlila grounds on Sunday, the possibility of flash protests by certain outfits and for maintenance of law and order during the ongoing festival season, the sources told PTI.
The Delhi Police, at whose disposal these CAPF units have been placed, has been asked to coordinate their deployment, the sources added.
